Real official documents from UMOA-Titres (https://www.umoatitres.org), retrieved 2026-10-04.
"Annonce au MTP" = official results announcement of an operation (the "Annonce" document of the
operation page); "Compte rendu" = the official auction result report of the same operation.
.txt files are `pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8` output of the PDF; one announcement is kept as the
original PDF (its table needs the printed word positions to be split into columns).

Annonce-au-MTP-NE-ES-01.10.2026.txt
  https://www.umoatitres.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Annonce-au-MTP-NE-ES-01.10.2026.pdf
  sha256 of PDF 0df3f1ff9c31272597ea7d1e5364229c48507a623627dc8a0679ad002d4d0366
  Niger, 4 OAT + 1 BAT; prices printed with 2 decimals (the report prints 4: announcement coarser)
  Report: tests/fixtures/umoa/Compte-Rendu-NE-ES-01.10.2026.txt
